leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define a theme contract with required properties
Implement a function that validates if an object conforms to the theme interface
Apply type assertions to ensure theme objects meet the contract requirements
Configure a theme checker utility that returns typed validation results
Manipulate theme data structures while maintaining type safety throughout operations
Initialize a sample theme object and test it against the contract checker
Render validation feedback based on the typed contract compliance results
